DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日は何についてのご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: What would you like to discuss today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 引っ越してきました。ごみを出す曜日は冊子で分かりましたが、出す場所が見つかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 収集曜日は分かるが集積所が不明と相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have just moved here. I found the rubbish collection days in the booklet, but I cannot find where to put it out.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you know the collection days but do not know the collection point. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 一戸建てですか、それとも集合住宅ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you live in a detached house or an apartment building?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 小さな集合住宅です。近くの道路沿いに網がありますが、そこを使ってよいか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 集合住宅と付近の網の利用可否が不明と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: A small apartment building. There is a net along a nearby road, but I do not know whether I may use that spot.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you live in an apartment building and do not know whether you may use the nearby net. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 集合住宅では建物で場所を決めている場合があります。管理者へはお尋ねになりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Apartment buildings sometimes designate their own collection point. Have you asked the manager?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだです。連絡先は契約書にあります。何を聞けばよいか整理したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 契約書の管理者へ聞く事項を整理したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Not yet. The contact details are in my contract. I would like to organize what I should ask.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for help organizing what to ask the manager whose contact details are in the contract. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 建物の指定集積所と、出す時間をお尋ねください。市の分別冊子はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Ask about the building's designated collection point and the time to put rubbish out. Do you have the city's sorting booklet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 持っています。場所と時間は管理者に聞き、分別はこの冊子を見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 集積所と時間は管理者へ分別は冊子で確認すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I do. I will ask the manager about the place and time, and use this booklet to check sorting.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will check the collection point and time with the manager and sorting in the booklet. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 冊子のこの欄に、分別で分からない場合の市の相談先があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: This section of the booklet lists the city's contact for questions about sorting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: その欄に印を付けました。今日は道路の網へ出さず、建物の場所を聞いてから出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 市相談先に印を付け指定場所確認後に排出すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have marked that section. I will not put rubbish under the roadside net today; I will put it out after asking about the building's collection point.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Mark the city's contact and say you will put rubbish out after confirming the designated place. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 場所が分かりましたら、冊子もお役立てください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Once you know the place, please make use of the booklet as well. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 検査の予約票をお持ちでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have your test appointment slip?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。九時とありますが、別の紙には八時半と書いてあります。どちらに来ればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 予約票の九時と別紙の八時半の違いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. It says nine o'clock, but another sheet says eight thirty. Which time should I come?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about the difference between nine on the appointment slip and eight thirty on the other sheet. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 九時は検査の予定時刻です。八時半は、この受付へお越しいただく時刻ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Nine is the scheduled test time. Eight thirty is the time to come to this reception desk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 早い方は受付の時間なのですね。検査の部屋へ直接行かず、まずここへ来ればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 受付へ先に来る順序を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: So the earlier time is for reception. Should I come here first rather than go directly to the test room?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm the order of coming to reception first. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。受付後の準備をご案内します。今日は説明のために来院されたのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. We will guide you through preparation after reception. You came to the hospital for an explanation today, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: そうです。検査日は来週です。朝に薬を飲むかも気になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 説明来院で検査は来週と答え朝の薬を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: That is right. The test is next week. I am also wondering whether to take my medicine in the morning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you came for an explanation and the test is next week, and ask about morning medicine. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 薬の扱いは医師か薬剤師に確認してください。薬の一覧はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please check with a doctor or pharmacist about your medicine. Do you have a list of your medicines?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 手帳を持っています。この薬について、検査前の朝の飲み方を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 薬手帳を示し検査前の飲み方を専門職へ尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have my medication record book. I would like to ask how to take this medicine on the morning before the test.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show your medication record book and ask a professional how to take it before the test. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当へその質問をお伝えします。予約票の受付時刻にも印を付けておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will pass that question to the person in charge. I will also mark the reception time on your appointment slip.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 八時半の受付に印が付きました。薬のことは、今から担当へ聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受付時刻を記し薬の相談へ進む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: The eight-thirty reception time is marked. I will now ask the person in charge about the medicine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Mark the reception time and proceed to ask about medicine. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、説明担当へご案内します。ご準備ありがとうございました。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will show you to the person giving the explanation. Thank you for preparing. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 駅前の写真を見て、電話で場所を伝える練習をしましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Let us look at a photo of the station forecourt and practice explaining a location by phone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 事故を見たとき、道の住所が分からなければ何を伝えるか練習したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 住所不明時の事故通報の場所説明を練習したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to practice what to say when I see an accident but do not know the street address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to practice explaining the location when reporting an accident without knowing the address. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この写真の時計の下にいるとして、目印を言ってみてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Imagine you are under the clock in this photo and try naming landmarks.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 駅の東口の前です。大きな時計の下にいます。これで伝わりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 東口と時計を目印に伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I am in front of the station's east exit. I am under the large clock. Does that convey the location?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the east exit and clock as landmarks. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 駅名も加えると、場所を絞れます。近くの信号や店の名前も役立ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Adding the station name will narrow down the location. Nearby traffic lights and shop names also help.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 駅名を加えます。道路の反対側に青い看板の店があり、目の前に横断歩道があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 駅名と看板と横断歩道を加える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will add the station name. Across the road is a shop with a blue sign, and right in front of me is a pedestrian crossing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Add the station name, sign, and pedestrian crossing. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 目印が増えましたね。建物に小さい住所表示があれば、それも見られます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: You have added more landmarks. If there is a small address sign on a building, you can also look at it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: あの壁に番地があります。安全な位置から読めるので、番号も伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 安全位置から読める壁の番地も述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: There is a street number on that wall. I can read it from a safe position, so I will give the number as well.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Also give the street number on the wall that you can read from a safe position. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 場所の説明ができました。次に何が起きたかを短く伝える練習をしますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: You have explained the location. Would you like to practice briefly explaining what happened next?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。最初に場所を言い、その後に見た状況を伝える順で、もう一度練習します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 場所の後に目撃状況を話す順で再練習を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will practice again in the order of first giving the location and then describing what I saw.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask to practice again in the order of location followed by the situation you witnessed. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、練習用の受話器で続けましょう。ご参加ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let us continue with the practice telephone handset. Thank you for participating.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お荷物の中身を伺えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Could you tell me what is inside your parcel?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 瓶に入ったオリーブ油です。ふたを閉めてありますが、この箱のまま送れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 油の瓶を箱のまま送れるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Olive oil in a glass bottle. The lid is closed, but can I send it in this box as it is?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may send the bottle of oil in the box as it is. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 液体の種類と容器の状態を確認します。瓶の周りに緩衝材は入れていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: We will check the type of liquid and the condition of the container. Is there cushioning around the bottle?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 薄い紙だけです。箱を傾けると瓶が動きます。どのように詰め直せばよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 紙だけで瓶が動くため詰め直し方を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Only thin paper. The bottle moves when I tilt the box. How should I repack it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask how to repack because there is only paper and the bottle moves. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 瓶を包む緩衝材と、漏れた場合に外へ広がりにくい袋をご用意ください。この見本をご覧いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please prepare cushioning to wrap the bottle and a bag that makes any leakage less likely to spread outside. You may look at this example.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 見本のように袋へ入れ、瓶の周りと底へ緩衝材を入れます。今日は材料を持っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 袋と緩衝材の方法を理解し材料未持参と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will put it in a bag like the example and place cushioning around the bottle and underneath it. I do not have the materials with me today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show you understand the bag and cushioning method and say you have not brought materials. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 梱包できてからお持ちください。送る相手の住所は国内ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please bring it after packing it. Is the recipient's address within Japan?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 国内です。先に箱の大きさを測って、材料を用意してから戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 国内宛てと答え箱を測り材料を用意すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: It is. I will measure the box first, prepare the materials, and then return.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the destination is within Japan and that you will measure the box and prepare materials. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの梱包案内もお渡しします。受付時には内容品を再度お伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will also give you this packing guide. Please tell us the contents again when we accept the parcel.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 案内を受け取ります。油の瓶と伝えて、箱の中で動かない状態にして持ってきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 案内を受け動かない梱包後に内容品を再申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take the guide. I will tell you it is a bottle of oil and bring it packed so it cannot move in the box.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Take the guide, pack it so it cannot move, and declare the contents again. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お待ちしております。それでは、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will be waiting for you. Please take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 事業用のお預け入れについてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your consultation about deposits for a business?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 店が閉まるのは夜八時です。翌朝まで売上を店に置くので、閉店後に預ける方法を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 閉店後に店の売上を預ける方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: The shop closes at eight at night. We keep the sales proceeds in the shop until the next morning, so I would like to know how to deposit them after closing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to deposit the shop's sales proceeds after closing. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 夜間金庫のご相談として担当へおつなぎできます。店舗の名義の口座はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: I can connect you to the person handling night-depository consultations. Do you have an account in the shop's name?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: あります。売上は私がまとめますが、利用の契約は店の代表者が行います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 店舗口座と本人の集計役と代表者の契約役を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: We do. I total the sales proceeds, but the shop's representative will make the service contract.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the shop account, your role of totaling sales, and the representative's role of signing the contract. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、代表者の方も説明をお聞きになる日時を調整しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then let us arrange a date and time when the representative can also hear the explanation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 来週火曜の午前なら、代表者と私が一緒に来られます。設備の使い方も見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 代表者と火曜午前来店可能で設備実演を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Next Tuesday morning, the representative and I can come together. I would also like to see how the equipment is used.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you and the representative can visit Tuesday morning and request an equipment demonstration. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当の空き時間を確認します。売上は紙幣だけでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will check the person's availability. Are the sales proceeds only banknotes?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 紙幣と硬貨です。両方を預ける袋や、記録する用紙も説明してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 紙幣と硬貨の袋と記録用紙の説明を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Banknotes and coins. I would also like an explanation of the bags for depositing both and the forms for recording them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for an explanation of bags for banknotes and coins and the record forms. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 火曜十時に説明の時間を設けられます。今日は利用申込みではなく、説明の予約を承ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We can set aside time for an explanation at ten on Tuesday. Today we will book the explanation, rather than take an application to use the service.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 十時でお願いします。代表者へ時刻を伝え、口座の資料と売上のまとめ方の見本を持って来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 火曜十時の説明を予約し資料持参を代表へ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Ten, please. I will tell the representative the time and bring the account documents and an example of how we total sales proceeds.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Book the explanation for ten on Tuesday and tell the representative about bringing documents. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 火曜十時の説明で承りました。お二人のご来店をお待ちしております。ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Your explanation is booked for ten on Tuesday. We look forward to seeing you both. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 冷凍食品をお買い求めでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you shopping for frozen food?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。家まで一時間かかるので、持ち帰るための保冷方法を先に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一時間の持帰りに保冷方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. It takes an hour to get home, so I would like to ask first how to keep it cold on the way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to keep food cold on the hour-long journey home. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 保冷バッグはお持ちですか。レジ後に使えるドライアイスの設備もございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have an insulated bag? We also have a dry-ice dispenser you can use after checkout.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 保冷バッグはあります。ドライアイスはレジで渡してもらうのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 保冷バッグ所持を伝えドライアイスの受取場所を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have an insulated bag. Do I get the dry ice at the checkout?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have an insulated bag and ask where to receive dry ice. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: レジで専用コインをお渡しし、出口横の機械で袋へ受け取る方式です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: We give you a special token at checkout, and you use the machine beside the exit to dispense it into a bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 機械は初めてです。操作と取扱いの注意が書かれた案内はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 初利用の機械の操作と注意書きを求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have not used the machine before. Is there a guide explaining how to operate it and precautions for handling it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for operating instructions and precautions for the machine you are using for the first time. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 機械の横にあります。素手で触れないことなど、案内に沿ってご利用ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: It is beside the machine. Please follow the instructions, including not touching it with bare hands.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。密閉しない持ち方も案内で読みます。バッグに冷凍品が収まる量だけ選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 注意書きとバッグ容量に合わせて選ぶと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I understand. I will also read the guide on how to carry it without sealing it airtight. I will choose only as much frozen food as fits in the bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will follow the precautions and choose an amount that fits your bag. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 商品を選ばれましたら、会計時にコインをお申し出ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once you have chosen your products, please ask for a token when paying.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今日は冷凍うどんを二袋にします。レジでコインを頼み、機械の案内を読んで受け取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二袋購入とコイン申請と案内確認の順を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Today I will buy two packs of frozen udon. I will ask for a token at checkout, read the machine's instructions, and collect the dry ice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide on two packs, requesting a token, and checking the instructions in that order. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: レジでもご希望を伺います。ご来店ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will also ask what you need at checkout. Thank you for visiting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 海辺の観察路の案内をお持ちになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like a guide to the seaside observation trail?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: お願いします。風が強くて、大きな紙を広げると持ちにくいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 強風で大きな案内を扱いにくいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, please. The wind is strong, so a large sheet is hard to hold when unfolded.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that a large guide is hard to handle in the strong wind. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 小さく折った案内もあります。今日はどの辺りまで歩く予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: We also have guides folded small. How far are you planning to walk today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 展望台までです。その部分だけ見えるように折りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 展望台までの範囲が見える折り方を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: To the observation deck. I would like to fold it so only that section is visible.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Request a fold that shows the route as far as the observation deck. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ここから展望台までの線は、この面にまとまっています。貸出しのクリップ板も使えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: The line from here to the observation deck is all on this side. You can also use a clipboard that we lend out.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 板を借りたいです。紙を挟んだら、歩くときはかばんへ入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: クリップ板を借り歩行時は収納すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to borrow a clipboard. After clipping the paper in, I will put it in my bag while walking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Borrow a clipboard and say you will put it away while walking. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 返却はこの案内所でお願いします。展望台からここへ戻る予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please return it to this information center. Are you planning to come back here from the observation deck?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。同じ道で戻ります。案内所が閉まる前に返せるよう、時刻も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同じ道で戻る予定と返却可能時刻を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will return along the same path. Please also tell me the time so I can return it before the information center closes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will return along the same path and ask the time by which you can return it. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 本日は四時までです。板には返却先の札を付けてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Today we are open until four. The board has a label showing where to return it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 四時より前に返します。展望台までの面を上にして挟めたので、出発します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 四時前の返却を約束し案内を挟んで出発する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will return it before four. I have clipped it with the side showing the route to the observation deck facing up, so I will set off.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Promise to return it before four, clip in the guide, and set off. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 板と案内をどうぞ。それでは、風にもお気をつけて散策をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27213-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here are the board and guide. Please take care in the wind and enjoy your walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 駅の無線通信について、お問い合わせですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your inquiry about the station's wireless connection?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 待合室で地図を見たいです。通信の印は出ましたが、地図のページが開きません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通信印は出るが地図が開かないと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to look at a map in the waiting room. The connection symbol appeared, but the map page will not open.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the connection symbol appears but the map will not open. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 接続した後に、利用の案内画面をご覧になりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: After connecting, did you look at the usage information screen?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 接続先を選んだだけです。案内画面は閉じてしまったかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 接続先選択のみで利用案内未確認と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I only selected the connection. I may have closed the information screen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you only selected the connection and have not checked the usage guide. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの掲示に、案内画面を開く手順があります。まず画面を開いて、利用条件をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: This notice explains how to open the information screen. First open it and read the terms of use.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 手順で開けました。条件を読んで、利用する方を選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 案内を開き条件を読み利用を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I opened it by following the steps. I will read the terms and select the option to use the service.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Open the guide, read the terms, and choose to use the service. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 完了の表示が出たら、地図のページをもう一度開いてみてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: When the completion message appears, try opening the map page again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 地図が出ました。見たい施設の名前を入れると、周辺の図も開けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 地図を開け施設検索もできたと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: The map appeared. When I enter the name of the facility I want to see, I can also open a map of the surrounding area.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report that you opened the map and could search for the facility as well. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この接続には、一回の利用時間があります。掲示の時間もご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: This connection has a time limit for each session. Please also check the time on the notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 時間を確認しました。見つけた施設の住所を手帳へ控えてから、地図を見終えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 利用時間を確認し目的施設の住所を控える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I checked the time. I will copy the address of the facility I found into my notebook before I finish looking at the map.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the usage time and note the address of your destination facility. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 接続できてよかったですね。それでは、待合室をどうぞご利用ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: I am glad you could connect. Please make use of the waiting room.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 本日の会議の傍聴をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to observe today's meeting?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。初めてなので、受付の方法を教えてください。発言せずに聞く予定です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会議を聞くため初回の傍聴受付を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. It is my first time, so please tell me how to register. I plan to listen without speaking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to register as a first-time observer to listen to the meeting. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの用紙へお名前を記入してください。資料は席でお読みいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please write your name on this form. You may read the materials at your seat.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 名前を書きました。資料へ自分でメモを書いてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 記名を済ませ配布資料へ書けるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have written my name. May I write my own notes on the materials?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: After writing your name, ask whether you may write on the handouts. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この資料は回収しますので、書き込みはご遠慮ください。ご自身のノートは使えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will collect these materials, so please do not write on them. You may use your own notebook.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、ノートに議題の番号を付けてメモします。終わる前に帰る場合はどうすればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分のノートを使い途中退席の方法を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I will take notes in my notebook with the agenda item numbers. What should I do if I leave before it ends?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Use your own notebook and ask how to leave partway through. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 静かに退席して、出口の箱へ資料をお戻しください。受付へもお声をかけてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please leave quietly and return the materials to the box at the exit. Please also tell reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 出口の箱ですね。今日は三時に帰る必要があるので、途中で退席するかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 三時帰宅のため途中退席の可能性を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: The box at the exit, right? I need to go home at three today, so I may leave partway through.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you may leave early because you need to go home at three. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。席はこちらです。録音についても、掲示のお願いをご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Your seat is here. Please also read the notice about recording.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 掲示を読みました。資料は読むために使い、記録は自分のノートに取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 掲示を読み資料と自分のノートを使い分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have read the notice. I will use the materials for reading and take notes in my own notebook.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Read the notice and use the materials and your own notebook for their respective purposes. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、こちらの席へどうぞ。お越しいただきありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please take this seat. Thank you for coming.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 診察室からお戻りですね。次は検査のご案内があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are back from the examination room. Next we will give you directions for a test.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 診察が終わったので、会計の番号を取るところでした。まだ検査があるのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 診察終了後も検査があるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: The consultation finished, so I was about to take a payment number. Is there still a test to do?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether there is a test even after the consultation has finished. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 医師からお渡しした紙に、検査受付へ進む指示があります。紙を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: The paper the doctor gave you instructs you to proceed to test reception. May I see it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。この印が検査へ行く意味なのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 医師の指示紙を示し印の意味を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here it is. So this mark means I should go for the test.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the doctor's instruction sheet and confirm what the mark means. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。今日の順番は検査、その後に会計です。検査受付の場所をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Today's order is the test, then payment. I will tell you where test reception is.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。会計の番号はまだ取っていません。先に検査受付でこの紙を出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 会計番号未取得を伝え先に検査受付へ行く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I have not taken a payment number yet. I will submit this paper at test reception first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have not taken a payment number and go to test reception first. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 廊下の先の青いカウンターです。検査が終わると、次の案内があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: It is the blue counter at the end of the corridor. You will receive further directions after the test.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 青いカウンターですね。かばんは持ったまま行けばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 案内場所を復唱し荷物持参を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: The blue counter, right? Should I take my bag with me?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Repeat the directed location and ask about taking your belongings. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。こちらへ戻る必要がある場合は、検査担当がご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. If you need to come back here, the test staff will tell you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 紙とかばんを持って進みます。今日の診察だけで全部終わったと思っていたので、順番が分かって助かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 紙と荷物を持ち検査後会計の順で進む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take the paper and my bag and go. I thought everything was finished with today's consultation, so understanding the order has helped.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Take your paper and belongings and proceed in the order of test then payment. Please say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、検査受付へどうぞ。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-27214-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then please go to test reception. Goodbye.
